history.note: live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend).

4.2.6-rs-m3.label: borg-rs M3 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v3): the Rust Borg carrying better-borg-c milestone 3's fixes (borg-rs#8; qualified pass, owner accepted).

4.2.6-rs-m4.label: borg-rs M4 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v4): the Rust Borg carrying better-borg-c milestone 4's fixes (borg-rs#11; qualified pass, owner accepted). The tag also carries an engine correction (cure-all on known curses, neo-angband-tracker#474), so its game differs from better-borg-c M4 beyond the Borg.

4.2.6-rs-m4-c.label: borg-rs 4.2.6-impact-v4, C Borg: the C Borg in borg-rs's tree with better-borg-c milestone 4's fixes, under the borgh frontend. The tag also carries an engine correction (cure-all on known curses, neo-angband-tracker#474), so its game differs from better-borg-c M4 beyond the Borg.
